## Regional unit

The analysed AOI covers 269.02 km² before the internal buffer and 254.01 km² after a 15 m buffer, with 190 polygons and elevations of approximately 4,597–6,364 m.

## Main result

The area-weighted regional rate is **−1.463 m yr⁻¹** (95% CI: −2.357 to −0.596), representing 96.5% of the AOI. At 850 kg m⁻³ this corresponds to **−1.243 m water equivalent yr⁻¹** (95% CI: −2.011 to −0.476).

The strongest negative trends occur at lower and middle-lower elevations. High-elevation bands have weaker support and wider uncertainty.

## InSAR context

The audited series has 33 ascending and 35 descending acquisitions on a 40 m EPSG:32719 grid. Monthly dU examples (+0.23 and −0.58 cm) are close to the 0.63–0.65 cm stable residual. Cumulative products and consistent uncertainty are required before a regional InSAR rate is reported.
